rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a tool or instrument used to do a job.

example.english: This tool is the implement I use for bicycle repairs.
example.traditional: 呢件工具係我整架單車時用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 gung1 geoi6 hai6 ngo5 zing2 gaa3 daan1 ce1 si4 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for farming implements rather than general tools.

example.english: This farming implement is what Uncle uses to work the fields.
example.traditional: 呢件農具係阿叔用嚟耕田㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 nung4 geoi6 hai6 aa3 suk1 jung6 lei4 gaang1 tin4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for instruments or utensils, especially in technical or formal contexts rather than ordinary hand tools.

example.english: These instruments must be sterilized before we implement the surgical procedure.
example.traditional: 呢批器具要先經過消毒，先可以實施手術程序。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 hei3 geoi6 jiu3 sin1 ging1 gwo3 siu1 duk6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sat6 si1 sau2 seot6 cing4 zeoi6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting a plan, policy, or decision into practice.

example.english: The government needs to implement this new policy as soon as possible.
example.traditional: 政府要盡快落實呢項新政策。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 lok6 sat6 ne1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this especially for carrying out instructions, orders, duties, or an established plan.

example.english: Everyone must implement the supervisor’s instructions.
example.traditional: 大家要按照上司嘅指示執行。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 jiu3 on3 ziu3 soeng6 si1 ge3 zi2 si6 zap1 hang4

rows.note: Use this especially for introducing and putting a policy, programme, or system into operation.

example.english: The government will implement the new waste-sorting system next month.
example.traditional: 政府下個月開始推行新嘅垃圾分類制度。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 teoi1 hang4 san1 ge3 laap6 saap3 fan1 leoi6 zai3 dou6
